reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR and "Every batch lab-tested" on the box, which is a nice touch for travel, but I stick to Pure Encapsulations, Thorne or Nature Made and look for an NSF or USP seal, and this has neither and zero reviews.
objection: Unknown brand with no reviews and no NSF or USP seal, so a lab report on their own QR code is not enough for me to swap out a brand I trust. Also nothing says how big the capsules are, and 2 a day of a big capsule would be hard to swallow.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a stated capsule size that is easy to swallow and a few hundred real reviews.
